stem:
The diagram shows Qadir's electric cell joined to a small lamp. End P is the raised metal cap. End Q is the flat metal base.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: P is the positive terminal and Q is the negative terminal; a closed path through the lamp lets the cell run the circuit.
P is the negative terminal and Q is the positive terminal; the raised cap is always negative.
Both P and Q are positive terminals, so the lamp can glow without a return path.
The cell can run the lamp even if the wire at Q is left disconnected.

teacher.key_rationale: On a common dry cell the raised cap P is positive and the flat base Q is negative; the cell runs the lamp only when the circuit is a closed path.
teacher.figure_note: Cell with raised cap P and flat base Q joined to a lamp.
